documents.title: Intimation Of Book Closure - Pursuant To Regulation 42 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
Intimation Of 34Th Annual General Meeting To Be Held On Tuesday, September 29, 2026 And Book Closure.
Clarification sought from California Software Company Ltd

analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued its Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26, convening its 34th Annual General Meeting for September 29, 2026. The management detailed resolutions concerning the re-appointment of directors, including Dr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah as an Independent Director and Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan as a Whole-time Director. The document outlines procedures for remote e-voting, video conferencing attendance, and inspection of statutory registers.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that approximately 68 percent of small business owners report using AI, reflecting an increase from 51 percent two years prior.
demand_outlook.quote: About 68% of small business owners report already using AI, up sharply from 51% just two years prior.

demand_outlook.claim: An additional 9 percent of small business owners plan to begin using AI within the next year.
demand_outlook.quote: An additional 9% plan to begin using AI within the next year, indicating that roughly three-quarters of small firms will soon be AI-powered.

orders_capacity.claim: The dSpeedUp digital ecosystem expanded to serve over 1,000 merchants.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that 42 percent of small businesses reported lacking the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: e.g. 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.

management_commitments.claim: Dr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah is re-appointed as an Independent Director for a second term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31, 2026 up to July 30, 2031.
management_commitments.quote: re-appointed as an Independent Director of the Company for a second term, not liable to retire by rotation, for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31,2026 up to July 30,2031.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan is re-appointed for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31, 2026 up to July 30, 2031.
management_commitments.quote: re-appointed as a Non-Executive, Non Independent Director, liable to retire by rotation, for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31,2026 up to July 30,2031.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that nearly 40 percent of entrepreneurs plan to create new jobs in 2025 because of AI-driven productivity gains.
management_commitments.quote: Crucially, most entrepreneurs see AI as an enabler of growth rather than a threat: around 80% say AI is enhancing (not replacing) their workforce, and nearly 40% plan to create new jobs in 2025 because of AI-driven productivity gains.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
